span.p:
Proxmox accepts a snapshot
create, list, rollback, delete

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Proxmox refuses:
this storage snapshots qcow2 only

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(51, 65, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
bpg ignores file_format on a clone — it copies the
source format. A declared value the template does not
have makes every later plan a replacement, which the
gate refuses. That takes out convergence and resize
too, not only the snapshot it was meant to enable.

div.style: color: rgb(51, 65, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
getCapabilities is called by the readiness probe every
few seconds and must never reach the hypervisor, so the
format is measured once and carried in configuration.
